title: RSVP collaborative BCI dataset from Zheng et al 2020
description: A cross-session EEG dataset for collaborative brain-computer interfaces based on rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP). Fourteen healthy participants, organized in seven pairs, completed two sessions of a target image detection task (human vs non-human images) with synchronized 62-channel EEG recording. The dataset supports research on P300/ERP-based target detection and collaborative BCI methods.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Synamps2 system at 1000 Hz from 62 channels, referenced to the vertex (Cz), with a 50 Hz line frequency. Images were presented in RSVP streams with a 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed 2 sessions of 3 runs, with pairs recorded simultaneously. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags.
